items: Bhargavastra — indigenous Counter-Swarm Drone System (SDAL, Nagpur); interception range 2.5 km.
ICG — 2 major policy reforms — gender-neutral officer induction.
COAS launches indigenous Xtreme Weather Grade (XWG) Diesel — effective down to -42°C.
IAF Exercise "ROTOR CLAP-III" — Counter-UAS, 3rd edition, Pokhran.
Indian Navy–US Navy EOD Exercise 2026 — 8th edition since 2005, Kochi.
Exercise Talisman Sabre 2027 announced — Aug 9-22, 2027, hosted by Australia & US; India to participate.
Exercise Udara Shakti 2026 — IAF + Royal Malaysian Air Force, Subang Air Base.
MAITREE-XV 2026 — India-Thailand joint exercise, 15th edition, held in Thailand.
MoD signs contract with General Atomics (GA-ASI) — leasing 2 MQ-9B Sea Guardian HALE RPAS drones for Indian Navy, 30-month lease.
India Optel Ltd (IOL) launches indigenous 'Garud' high-resolution binoculars (7.6° FoV) — Ordnance Factory, Dehradun.
Indian Army Chief Gen Dhiraj Seth conferred Honorary General of the Nepal Army by President Ramchandra Paudel.
